problem_statement:
Bug#35478833 : set persist authentication_ldap_simple_bind_root_pwd
               is not saving password

Description:
Variable value of authentication_ldap_simple_bind_root_pwd is
data masked. This prevents the real variable value from being
persisted when set persist is used.

Persisting the sensitive variable creates a new entry without removing
the previous entry of the variable in the configuration file.

The server does not start if persisted sensitive variables
cannot be interpreted even if the server option
persist_sensitive_variables_in_plaintext is set to ON.
As documented the server should start with a warning in this case.
